purpose: Fixed exploratory texture/instrument-family descriptions; ranking is diagnostic and cannot identify the true source instrument.

descriptions.low_distorted_synth: Music featuring a deep low pitched distorted synthesizer playing a crunchy sustained riff.
descriptions.detuned_analog_bass: Music featuring a deep detuned analog synthesizer bass with a warm dark sustained tone.
descriptions.crunchy_poly_synth: Music featuring low crunchy synthesizer chords with heavy saturated harmonics.
descriptions.low_distorted_guitar: Music featuring a low tuned distorted electric guitar playing a heavy crunchy riff.
descriptions.electric_bass: Music featuring a low electric bass guitar playing a rhythmic grooving bassline.
descriptions.sliding_808: Music featuring a deep sliding 808 sub bass with gliding notes.
descriptions.clean_sub: Music featuring a very deep clean sine wave sub bass.
descriptions.dark_pad: Music featuring long soft dark atmospheric synthesizer pads.
descriptions.growling_bass: Music featuring a moving growling wobbling synthesizer bass with resonant filter motion.
descriptions.electric_piano: Music featuring mellow electric piano chords and rhythmic keyboard stabs.
descriptions.plucked_synth: Music featuring a low plucked synthesizer bass playing short sharp rhythmic notes.
descriptions.organ_synth: Music featuring a dark low organ-like synthesizer tone with rich sustained harmonics.
